post.text: Google Maps notify police if you go over the speed limit for more than 3 seconds https://t.co/n1fFl0bOSS

description.description: A digital illustration showing a navigation app on a smartphone screen. The map displays a blue arrow on Route 101 near Eel Creek and Lakeside State Airport. Overlaid on the map is a fake warning notification showing a 45 MPH speed limit and a current speed of 61 MPH. The notification states 'You are speeding' and 'Slow down or we notify the police', with an active progress bar counting down to call the police.
description.ocrText: Sherwood St, Lakeside State Airport-9S3, Eel Creek, Airport Way, Wildwood Dr, 101, Sherry Barbie Ln, Spinreel Rd, 61 MPH, 45 MPH, You are speeding, Slow down or we notify the police, Wait what?, Calling police in 2s
